trail.text: Flagged latency and error spikes point at several suspects — digging in to isolate the root cause.
Early signs suggest a downstream slowdown rippling upward — now mapping the full scope to find the origin.
Timing shows the security service faltered first — now verifying the exact sequence to confirm it.
The pattern is clear — now gathering final proof that downstream errors are fallout, not the source.

causes.reasoning: Earliest sharp latency explosion 0.10s to 6.49s mean (max 28.7s) at 10s affecting p90/p95/p99/p50 with no CPU or mongo change, indicating injected delay that callers then wait on.
Early coincident latency rise from 8s with p95 0.43s to 1.98s and p99 1.28s to 5.89s and no resource change, consistent with upstream caller victim amplifying the security delay.
Sharp latency jump p95 0.099s to 0.89s and p99 0.17s to 2.68s starting 13-23s after security with flat CPU, classic downstream waiting victim.
User-visible errors appear late at 103s plus p90 latency 0.038s to 1.20s from 16s with falling CPU, showing order fails as consequence of waiting on slow dependencies.
Latency 0.083s to 0.72s from 11s simultaneous with security plus late 4x CPU surge exceeding at 79s, indicating queue/retry buildup as victim not origin.
